english.meaning: a famous brand name, especially on clothes and bags
english.note: 周身名牌 means covered in designer labels.

exampleSentences.english: I don’t get some people—why are they covered in designer labels?
exampleSentences.traditional: 我都唔明有啲人呢，點解呢周身名牌𡃉喎。

exampleSentences.english: Actually, she only makes money to buy designer clothes, nice bags, and that sort of thing.
exampleSentences.traditional: 其實佢揾錢個目的都係買名牌啊，乜乜乜乜衫啊，靚衫啊、靚袋啊，嗰啲噉嘅嘢啫嗎。
